wildest.definition: Form of wild (superlative): Untamed; not domesticated.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willing.definition: Form of will (gerund participle present): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wilt.definition: Form of will (archaic indicative present second-person singular): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wilted.definition: Form of wilt (participle past): To droop or become limp and flaccid (as a dying leaf or flower).

wimple.definition: A cloth which usually covers the head and is worn around the neck and chin. It was worn by women in medieval Europe and is still worn by nuns in certain orders.

wimples.definition: Form of wimple (plural): A cloth which usually covers the head and is worn around the neck and chin. It was worn by women in medieval Europe and is still worn by nuns in certain orders.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

winding.definition: Form of wind (gerund participle present): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

windings.definition: Form of winding (plural): gerund of wind.

window.definition: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

winking.definition: Form of wink (gerund participle present): To close one's eyes in sleep.

winks.definition: Form of wink (indicative present singular third-person): To close one's eyes in sleep.

winners.definition: Form of winner (plural): One who has won or often wins.

winning.definition: Form of win (gerund participle present): To conquer, defeat.

wiped.definition: Form of wipe (participle past): To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

wiping.definition: Form of wipe (gerund participle present): To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wisely.definition: In a wise manner; using good judgement.

wiser.definition: Form of wise (comparative): Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wished.definition: Form of wish (participle past): To desire; to want.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withal.definition: Together with the rest; besides; in addition.

withall.definition: Form of withal (archaic not-comparable): Together with the rest; besides; in addition.

withdraw.definition: To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withdrew.definition: Form of withdraw (past): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withers.definition: Form of wither (indicative present singular third-person): To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

withstood.definition: Form of withstand (participle past): To resist or endure (something) successfully.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnessed.definition: Form of witness (participle past): To furnish proof of, to show.

witticism.definition: A witty remark; a bon mot; an epigram; a zinger.

woe.definition: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

women’s.definition: Possessive case of women: belonging to some or all female humans.

won.definition: Form of win (participle past): To conquer, defeat.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wondered.definition: Form of wonder (participle past): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

wondering.definition: Form of wonder (gerund participle present): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wont.definition: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

woods.definition: Form of wood (plural): The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wore.definition: Form of wear (past): To have on.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workmen.definition: Form of workman (plural): A man who labours for wages.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worries.definition: Form of worry (indicative present singular third-person): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worry.definition: To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worrying.definition: Form of worry (gerund participle present): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

wot.definition: Form of wit (first-person indicative present singular): To know, be aware of (constructed with of when used intransitively).

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wouldst.definition: Form of will (archaic indicative past second-person singular): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wrapping.definition: Form of wrap (gerund participle present): To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wrested.definition: Form of wrest (participle past): To pull or twist violently.

wrinkling.definition: Form of wrinkle (gerund participle present): To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

wrists.definition: Form of wrist (plural): The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writhing.definition: Form of writhe (gerund participle present): To twist, wring (something).

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wronged.definition: Form of wrong (participle past): To treat unjustly; to injure or harm; to do wrong by.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

wry.definition: Turned away, contorted (of the face or body).

y.definition: Form of year (abbreviation): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

y-clept.definition: Form of clepe (participle past): To give a call; cry out; appeal.

yad.definition: A pointer used in the ritual of Torah-reading.

yad’s.definition: A pointer used in the ritual of Torah-reading.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yawn.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yokel.definition: A person from or living in the countryside, viewed as being unsophisticated or naive.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.

youth’s.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zebra.definition: Any of three species of subgenus Hippotigris: Equus grevyi, Equus quagga, or Equus zebra, all with black and white stripes and native to Africa.

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.

zutho.definition: A traditional rice wine brewed in Nagaland, a thick white beverage with a fruity aroma and sour taste.
